embed.title: 📜 Bounty System Guide
embed.description:
**Bounty** is a mission system where you earn rewards by completing specific server event targets.

**How to Use:**
1. Use `/bounty submit` to upload your proof.
2. Wait for a review by the Guild Gals.
3. Receive your rewards once approved.
embed.footer: RainRust v2.1 | Use /bounty for more info

embed.title: 🎰 Gacha System
embed.description:
**Gacha** is a random reward system utilizing tickets.

**Commands:**
• `/gacha pull` - Single pull (1 ticket)
• `/gacha multi` - Multi pull (10 tickets)

**Rates:**
• SSR: 2%
• SR: 10%
• R: 88%

embed.title: 📋 Server Rules
embed.description:
**General Rules:**
1. No spam or self-promotion.
2. Be respectful to all members.
3. No NSFW content.
4. Follow Discord ToS.

**Bounty Rules:**
1. Only HR equipment allowed for Gold/Silver.
2. No MS (Monster Skill) for specific categories.
3. Submit clear, high-quality screenshots.
4. Strictly one submission per person.
embed.footer: Violations may result in disciplinary action

embed.title: 🎁 Bounty Rewards
embed.description:
**Bronze Category:**
• Coins: 1,000 - 5,000
• Tickets: 1-3
• Basic Equipment

**Silver Category:**
• Coins: 5,000 - 15,000
• Tickets: 3-5
• Rare Equipment

**Gold Category:**
• Coins: 15,000 - 50,000
• Tickets: 5-10
• Epic/Legendary Equipment
embed.footer: Rewards may vary based on BBQ level

embed.title: 🏆 Title System
embed.description:
**Bounty Titles:**
• Bronze Bounty Hunter - Complete 10 Bronze bounties
• Silver Bounty Hunter - Complete 10 Silver bounties
• Gold Bounty Hunter - Complete 10 Gold bounties

**Trading Titles:**
• Bronze Trader - Complete 50 trades
• Silver Trader - Complete 100 trades
• Gold Trader - Complete 250 trades

**Benefits:**
• Bonus bounty coins (10-30%)
• Trading discounts (10-30%)

embed.title: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions
embed.description:
**Q: How do I submit a bounty?**
A: Use `/bounty submit` and attach your screenshot.

**Q: Why was my bounty rejected?**
A: Check the rejection reason provided. Common issues include wrong equipment or low-quality screenshots.

**Q: How long does the review take?**
A: Usually within 24 hours. Contact the Guild Gals if it takes longer.

**Q: Can I submit multiple bounties?**
A: No, please wait for your current submission to be reviewed before submitting another.
embed.footer: Still have questions? Ask in the #help channel

embed.title: 🍖 BBQ Progress Guide
embed.description:
**BBQ System:**
Complete bounties to progress through BBQ levels (01-25).

**Requirements:**
• BBQ 01-05: Bronze bounties
• BBQ 06-15: Silver bounties
• BBQ 16-25: Gold bounties

**Benefits:**
• Higher BBQ = Better rewards
• Access to exclusive equipment
• Title progression
embed.footer: Current BBQ level is shown in your profile

embed.title: 🤖 RainRust Bot - Help Menu
embed.description:
**Available Commands:**

**Bounty:**
• `/bounty` - View bounty info
• `/bounty submit` - Submit bounty
• `/cooldown` - Check cooldown

**Gacha:**
• `/gacha pull` - Single pull
• `/gacha multi` - Multi pull

**Trading:**
• `/trading create` - List item
• `/trading buy` - Buy item

**Info:**
• `!bounty` - Bounty guide
• `!rules` - Server rules
• `!faq` - FAQ
embed.footer: RainRust v2.1 | Developed for the MHF-Z Community

embed.title: 📜 Rain Server MHFZ - Server Rules
embed.description: **Welcome to Rain Server MHFZ!**\n\nPlease read and adhere to the following rules to maintain a comfortable environment.

fields.name: ⚔️ GAMEPLAY RULES
fields.value:
1. Cheat, hacks, or third-party tools are strictly prohibited.
2. Do not exploit game bugs.
3. HR gear is mandatory for Gold category bounties.
4. Using Monster Skills (MS) is forbidden for specific bounties.
5. Submit clear, non-blurry screenshots.

fields.name: 💬 CHAT & COMMUNICATION
fields.value:
1. No spamming, flooding, or excessive use of caps.
2. SFW/NSFW content must be kept in appropriate channels.
3. Respect all members; toxic behavior or harassment is not tolerated.
4. Do not promote other servers without Admin permission.
5. Use channels according to their designated topics.

fields.name: 🎯 BOUNTY SYSTEM
fields.value:
1. One submission per person; wait for the current review to finish.
2. Cooldown: 40 hours for the same category.
3. Cooldown: 20 hours for different categories.
4. Rewards are distributed automatically upon approval.
5. Rejections will add 1 hour to your cooldown.

fields.name: ⚔️ TRADING & MARKET
fields.value:
1. No price manipulation or scamming.
2. Only trade legitimate items (no duped items).
3. Minimum price: 100 BC (Bounty Coins).
4. Market Tax: 5% of the selling price.
5. Admins are not responsible for trades between members.

fields.name: 🏆 TITLES & RANKS
fields.value:
1. Titles are earned by completing bounties.
2. Titles provide a Bounty Coin bonus (10-30%).
3. Titles provide a trading discount (10-30%).
4. Titles are permanent once acquired.
5. Buying/selling accounts or titles is strictly forbidden.

fields.name: 🔧 GENERAL RULES
fields.value:
1. Follow Discord Terms of Service.
2. Obey instructions from Admins & Moderators.
3. Do not mention Admins without an urgent reason.
4. Report bugs/errors to the staff immediately.
5. Rules are subject to change at any time.

fields.name: ⚠️ PENALTIES
fields.value:
- Warning 1-3: Verbal/Direct Warning.
- Warning 4: 24-hour Mute.
- Warning 5: Kick from server.
- Severe Violations: Permanent Ban.

fields.name: 📞 STAFF CONTACT
fields.value:
For questions or assistance, contact:
- Admin: @Admin Role
- Moderator: @Moderator Role
- Guild Gals: @Guild Gals Role
